items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I finally ran into a very sweet guy, Foster, a dancer... I had a studio because of Foster

ctx.x: But they unceremoniously ushered you out.

So that was the six months. I left. I went to Chicago. Slept in the streets a little bit. I finally ran into a very sweet guy, Foster, a dancer, Foster – it’ll come to me. Anyway, this guy had a studio, because he went with – Foster Johnson – he went with a woman who – what do you call a head of a . . .?
